newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 9.31 points at 6,473.25 on Tuesday as the market rally was held back by a sell-off in technology shares.

* Indonesia, European Union and Japan postponed earlier plans to hold separate meetings over Indonesia's disputed national car policy on the sidelines of the World Trade Organization forum in Singapore.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 7.90 points, or 1.24 percent, to close at 626.68 points on Tuesday following a steep drop in heavyweight Telkom combined with profit-taking in selected counters.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,351.45/51.70 in early trading against the opening of 2,351.50/52.00.
* Bank Umum Servitia which is being listed today.
* Telkom on market talk that the government has given approval for the state-owned telecommunications firm to make a second share offering next year.
* Branta Mulia on talk that Du Pont of the United States was likely to take a stake in the tyre-related goods manufacturer.
* Plastic packaging manufacturer Dynaplast on rights issue announcement and expected production capacity expansion.
* Panin Insurance following reports of recent significant changes of share ownership in the company.
* Finance firm Perdana Cipta on market talk of a possible acquisition.
